correctness.rationale: Direct subtraction of the full N-oscillator map gives F(x)=x-A sin x+B(1-cos x). F(x)>0 for all x>0 exactly when A<=1, while upper confinement is the global minimization H_A(t)=(t-A sin t)/(1-cos t); derivative sign follows from decreasing t cot(t/2) on (0,pi) and positivity on (pi,2pi), giving one minimizer and Bc(1)=0. Bc strictly falls as A grows, producing unique Kc on each physical positive-lag ray. F(x)-x has the unique repelling root 2 arctan(A/B); monotone orbits converge to a synchronizing endpoint. G(t,K) has G=Gy=0, Gyy=(A-cos t)/sin t>0 and Gk=-t/K<0, yielding the stated sqrt(K-Kc) interval. Expansion at A=1 gives sqrt(8/3)*sqrt(1-A) and Kc=1+(1/2-3d²/8)beta²+O(beta⁴). Direct independent root/calibration at d=1/2,beta=pi/4 yields Kc=1.29948735520175. The analysis is confined to exactly invariant two-cluster data; it makes no transverse stability assertion.
